about: PhysioNet 2026 cognitive-impairment classification, one prediction per subject.
_doc: PhysioNet 2026 cognitive-impairment classification. label_mode cognitive_impairment is the reader's mode (adapters/physionet2026.py LABEL_MODES): 1 impaired / 0 not, from each epoch's cognitive_impairment field through CI_TO_LABEL; ci_label is the metadata field that mode writes.
